en.headline: Retailers see Golden Week lift, groups warn gains may be modest
en.dek: Some shops forecast double-digit growth as 1.29 million mainland visitors are expected, but an economist said receipts may not rise in line with arrivals.
body: Some Hong Kong retailers are forecasting double-digit sales growth over the National Day Golden Week, while trade groups have warned that cautious spending could keep the wider lift modest, the South China Morning Post reported on Thursday morning.

The caution sits beside an official estimate that about 1.29 million mainland visitors will arrive between 1 and 7 October, with average daily arrivals projected to be more than 5 per cent above last year's. Businesses have been offering discounts, shopping rewards and events, and some hotels are looking to late bookings to fill remaining rooms, the paper reported.
Gary Ng Cheuk-yan, a senior economist at Natixis Corporate and Investment Bank, said total retail receipts might still rise, but that the growth would be out of proportion to the number of arrivals.

The holiday period is the mainland Golden Week. In Hong Kong, Thursday is a public holiday for National Day; Friday is a normal working day. Officials have already said they expect the visitor surge to be the main feature of the week for shops, restaurants and attractions.

zh.headline: 黃金周有商戶料銷售雙位數增長 團體提醒升幅或有限
zh.dek: 官方估計十一黃金周約129萬內地旅客來港，有商戶看好銷售，但經濟學家指零售額升幅未必與人流同步。
body: 《南華早報》周四早上報道，部分本港零售商預計國慶黃金周銷售可錄得雙位數增長，但商會提醒旅客消費審慎，整體升幅可能有限。
這與官方估計互相對照：10月1日至7日約有129萬內地旅客來港，日均入境人數料較去年同期多逾百分之五。報道指，商戶推出折扣、購物獎賞及活動，部分酒店則指望遲來的訂房填滿餘下房間。
法巴投資銀行高級經濟學家吳卓殷說，零售總額仍可能上升，但增長幅度未必與旅客人數成正比。
內地正值黃金周。本港周四是國慶公眾假期，周五回復上班。當局早前已表示，這一周對商店、食肆和景點的主要變量是入境人流。
